method: Read-only public primary manufacturer, distributor and assembler pages retrieved with web search/open/find. No authenticated supplier sessions, reservations, RFQs, carts or orders were used.
freshness_policy: The verification timestamp records when evidence was inspected, not a guarantee of live inventory. The web tool's reported crawl age is preserved separately. Same-day public page observations have priority over older snippets; conflicting cached counts are retained as historical evidence. Public catalog presence does not establish allocated assembly stock.

manufacturer.name: Seeed Studio
manufacturer.notes: Manufacturer page identifies SKU113991054 and displays In stock. No numerical stock quantity was exposed. An older two-week search result displayed $4.99; the same-day opened page is the price basis here.

distributors.name: LCSC
distributors.notes: The same-day canonical product page displays Out of Stock and Notify Me. This overrides older positive-stock snapshots for the present report, but does not establish authenticated allocation or lead time.

distributors.name: DigiKey US
distributors.notes: Public distributor stock for loose-board purchase. DigiKey's standard manufacturer lead time is separate from its in-stock quantity. Tariff may apply to US shipping; shipping/tax/cart totals were not checked. This stock does not establish availability in JLCPCB's assembly library.

jlcpcb.notes: Opened public JLCPCB page establishes listing and assembly metadata but exposes no stock quantity or orderable quantity in retrieved text. Do not infer stock from listing presence or transfer LCSC stock to JLCPCB. JLCPCB says purchased components are stored for future PCBA orders and cannot be shipped separately.

requested_parts.notes: Exact-number searches including Seeed, ESP32 and ESP32C3, plus manufacturer-domain searches, did not return a matching manufacturer or distributor product. Absence of a search result is not proof that the SKU never existed. Do not place113991355 into a purchasing BOM as a verified XIAO ESP32C3 part.

related_manufacturer_confirmed_product.relationship: Manufacturer calls it the pre-soldered version of XIAO ESP32C3. This confirms product identity and header configuration only; no carrier fit or electrical equivalence approval is asserted.

manufacturer.name: Espressif Systems
manufacturer.notes: Manufacturer lists the exact N4 variant with sample/distributor links and a bulk contact route. It does not expose manufacturer-held inventory. The $1.90 AliExpress sample reference price is not a direct manufacturer fulfillment quote.

distributors.name: LCSC
distributors.notes: Same-day canonical public stock observation. Stock is volatile and has not been reserved. The product FAQ contains4514 units, which conflicts with the main quantity display; the main stock display is used.

jlcpcb.notes: Yesterday-crawled opened page lists the exact part and assembly metadata but does not expose stock/order quantity in retrieved text. The6055/5167 counts come only from a three-week search cache and cannot establish current JLCPCB allocation. JLCPCB says purchased components are for future PCBA orders and cannot be shipped separately.
